description: Public support-only tool selection honors interface-body exclusion and the interface filament flush costs.

mutants.description: Force the body-exclusion setting false while preserving the original variable use. The true row must contain both the non-interface and interface tools, while the false row is pinned to the interface tool by the distinct interface flush row.
Use the first flush-matrix row instead of the interface filament row for fallback selection. The body-allowed row must then select tool 0 instead of the pinned interface destination.
